skills.name: codebase-explore
skills.description: Use when gathering background codebase context as part of a larger workflow, such as the brainstorming or planning explore step, or before modifying unfamiliar code to understand architecture and structure. Not for a direct one-off question (use codebase-ask), a named symbol's callers/callees (use codebase-graph), or the effect of a diff (use codebase-impact).

skills.name: codebase-ask
skills.description: Use when the user asks a direct natural-language question about the codebase: 'where does X happen', 'how does X work', 'anything similar to X', 'what should I know before adding X'. Not for ambient context during brainstorming/planning (use codebase-explore), call graphs of a named symbol (use codebase-graph), or what a diff affects (use codebase-impact).

skills.name: codebase-index
skills.description: Use when the codebase index must be built or refreshed: 'index this repo', 'reindex', 'index is stale', or when other codebase skills report no index. This only builds the index; to answer questions use codebase-ask, codebase-graph, or codebase-impact.

skills.name: codebase-impact
skills.description: Use when the user asks what recent code changes affect: 'what did my changes break', 'blast radius of this diff', 'what might break', 'which tests are affected'. Works from a git diff or base SHA. Not for questions about code that has not changed (use codebase-ask) or one symbol's callers (use codebase-graph).

skills.name: codebase-graph
skills.description: Use when the user names a specific symbol and wants its relationships: 'who calls X', 'what does X call', 'call graph for X', 'dependencies of X'. Supports depth and direction. Not for general how/where questions (use codebase-ask) or diff-based impact (use codebase-impact).

commands.name: codebase-ask
commands.description: Ask a question about the codebase. <question>

commands.name: codebase-index
commands.description: Build or refresh the codebase index. [--mode full|moderate|fast]

commands.name: codebase-impact
commands.description: Show what your recent changes affect. [--base <sha>]

commands.name: codebase-graph
commands.description: Show a symbol's callers and callees. <symbol> [--depth 1-5] [--direction inbound|outbound|both]
